I looked for Cartwheels Gym Centre's own site (cartwheelsgymcentre.com — a Georgetown/Halton Hills gymnastics club, not to be confused with the separate business "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre" at a similar address, which is a different operator and not the one asked about).

**What I could actually open:** Only the home page (`https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/`) rendered for me. The `programs.php` and `registration.php` pages — where the toddler class details, eligibility rules, and pricing actually live — both refused the fetch (`url_not_allowed`) on repeated tries. I'm reporting those as unopened pages, not as "nothing posted."

**From the home page I did read:** the site's own "Important Dates" notice states 
registrations filled quickly for a recent session
, and separately the page itself (fetched directly) states that registration opens Saturday October 15 for Terms 2, 3 and 4, with a full-year discount for registering before October 14 — meaning Term 1 (the fall term) registration was already running before that window, not something still to come.

**From `programs.php` (blocked page — this is snippet-only, not confirmed by opening it):** the toddler-relevant programs are Tiny Gym and Mini Gym. The eligibility text in the snippet reads that a child who is 
not yet three years plus six months prior to the term start date must register into Tiny Gym
, while Mini Gym requires that they 
have just participated in Tiny Gym and are showing readiness to participate without a parent, or are already 3½ when registering
, and separately that Mini Gym participants must be 
fully toilet trained (no pull-ups)
. On price and exact class times, the same page states plainly that 
availability and pricing are only available by logging into the registration website, since pricing fluctuates term by term
 — so there is no published weekday/time grid or fee figure I can hand over; it sits behind their registration login, and I did not have access to that system.

Nothing here should go to the parent as "the schedule" — no page I could open had the actual weekday/time grid or a dollar figure for fall, and the one page that likely does (programs.php) I was blocked from reading. What's solid enough to relay: this is the right club for a toddler by name, Tiny Gym is the toddler-with-parent tier, Mini Gym is the step after, and fall registration is almost certainly open right now rather than "not posted yet" — but the exact class time and price need a follow-up (a phone call to 905-702-9904, or someone with access retrying `programs.php`/`registration.php`, since my fetches to both were refused outright rather than returning empty).
